senses.gloss: f. (סִיב I) gray head, old age. Targ. II Esth. VII, 9.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:15">Targ. Gen. XV, 15</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="U00790"><he>שֵׂיבוּ</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 33:25">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXIII, 25</cite> <he>סָבוּ׳</he>.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:7:1">Cant. R. to VIII, 7</cite> <he>דלא שבקת לסֵיבוּתָיךְ כלום</he> that thou didst leave nothing for thyself in thy old age; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>; a. e.—
Yeb. 65ᵇ מַסֵּיבוּ דילה (not … בי) = מה ס׳ what about her (my) old age?—Trnsf. old men, elders.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:24">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 24</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>אפשר שהס׳ הללו טועים וכ׳</he> is it possible that these elders &c., v. <cite ref="J00689"><he>יְשִׁיבָה</he></cite>.
